title: Zero Gravity Crispy Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A sweet and shattering Syrian dish featuring cream of tartar, perfect for a weeknight dinner, and friendly to all diets including Buddhist temple friendly
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together cream of tartar, olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly
Thread the chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Cook the kebabs in the air fryer for 10 minutes, shaking halfway through
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and honey
Brush the lemon honey mixture onto the kebabs during the last minute of cooking
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
